spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (ऋ) कुदृ (कोदयति)
To lie, to speak falsely: see कुद्र.

m. (-लः)
1 Mountain ebony.
2 A kind of spade: see कुद्दाल.

m. (-लः)
1 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) also काञ्चन.
2 A kind of spade or hoe.
E.
कु the earth, and दल to divide, with उत् prefixed, and अण् affix, or with दॄ to divide, कुद्दार; also कुदाल, &c.

mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि)
Having bad eyes.
f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Heterodox doctrine, as that of the Sāṃkhyas, &c.
2 Weak sight.
3 Evil eye.
E.
कु bad, दृष्टि sight.

m. (-रः)
See the next; sometimes also written कुदार.

m. (-रः)
The offspring of a Brahman woman by a Ṛṣi, begotten during menstruation.
E.
कु bad, उदर belly.

n. (-लं)
An opening bud: see कुड्मल.

r. 10th cl. (इ) कुद्रि (कुंद्रयति)
To speak falsely, to lie: some read this root कुदृ.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A dwelling raised on a platform or scaffold. It is sometimes written कुद्रङ्क.
E.
कु the earth, and द्रङ्ग what goes.

m. (-वः)
A kind of grass, the grain of which is eaten by the poor, (Paspalum scrobiculatum); also कोद्रव.
E.
कु the earth, and द्रु to be fixed, अच् aff.
